scanner_rules: Frozen MLP2; no parameter optimization, no extra securities or current status filter
entry_model: Completed contiguous RTH 5m bars available end+1 second; buy only at first later 5m OPEN before 5m expiry if open*(1+cost)<=limit; no intrabar entry; one intent per symbol/session; single shared cash/risk account.
stop_partial: Unchanged manage: stop first on ambiguous bars; gap stop uses min(open,stop) less cost; 15% partial at 3R less cost. Existing protective stops continue overnight.
daily_trailing_exit: At each premarket, previous completed vendor 1Day close < EMA9 computed on preceding 160 vendor daily bars (split-adjusted through current effective date) marks existing holding for exit at first observed regular-session open. Never compare vendor EMA to a different RTH aggregate close. No intraday EMA exit. Final period holdings marked without forced sale.
missing_data_primary: HALT on missing/invalid held-position 5m bar, missing prior daily history for held names, unresolved held corporate action/fractional entitlement. No terminal return claim after halt. Candidate gaps invalidate opening prefix without deleting already executed entries.
missing_data_secondary: Prespecified OBSERVED_ONLY diagnostic carries held marks across absent 5m bars and processes protective/trailing orders at next actual observed bar; records every gap and stale-mark limitation. Does not certify unobserved risk or executable return; invalid bars and unresolved actions still halt. Never use secondary to replace failed primary certification.
corporate_actions: Frozen prior mechanical accounting: effective-date splits, ex-date dividend receivables, payable-date spendable cash, unresolved actions halt. Retrospective records not first-availability verified.
source: Existing cached and supplemental read-only Alpaca raw SIP 5Min data; symbol asof 2025-04-25; daily convention unchanged; no 2026 prices. Supplemental coverage from first candidate session through period end, including sessions no longer on watchlist.
data_identity: Supplemental values override an overlapping cached bar only if identical; differences halt preparation and require disclosed data revision review.
benchmark: SPY buy-and-hold cash-funded at first observed open with same modeled entry cost, final observed close marked; no forced terminal sale. SPY is comparison only, not candidate binding. Dividend accounting disclosed.
scope_limitations: 2025 outcomes already exposed; not independent out-of-sample
Archived fixed 4002-name name-filter cohort; not certified dynamic security membership/tradability/sector
Final corrected daily/intraday bars and retrospective corporate actions; first availability not proved
No quotes, guaranteed fills or verified explicit broker/regulatory fees; cost sensitivity is not fee certification
